headline: Burgan Bank Raises Capital Through Rights Issue to Strengthen Upcoming Growth Phase
summary: Burgan Bank is raising capital through a rights issue to strengthen its capital base and financial flexibility. Subscription remains open until 1 p.m. Kuwait time on 14 September.
why: Burgan Bank is a Kuwaiti lender. Rights issues let existing shareholders buy new shares, raising equity capital to support lending growth.
